theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cone_sector_endpoint_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < δ → 1 ≤ k → a ∈ C.support → (∀ t φ : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 < φ → φ < δ → HasMassDensity C (t • (Real.cos φ • a + Real.sin φ • e)) k ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ C.support ∩ ball (t • (Real.cos φ • a + Real.sin φ • e)) r ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) → HasMassDensity C a k
